Codex review: blocked before merge. ## What this changes This PR preserves authored checklist completion and displays live delegated activity separately across Control UI progress surfaces. **Example:** Prepare the report has one completed step, one in-progress step, one pending step, and five children: two running and three queued. - **Before:** Successful parent completion gives the unfinished step a completion check. - **After:** The step remains unfinished, and a separate line shows Delegated work: 2 running · 3 queued. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | Strong visual proof supports the UI repair, but product direction and unresolved required CI checks prevent merge readiness. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** ✨ media proof bonus | Sufficient (screenshot): Inspected Chromium screenshots exercise the real Control UI against synthetic Gateway state: unfinished steps remain unfinished with two running and three queued children, child failure updates separately, and mobile Details retains the checklist after reload; no live provider or channel coverage is claimed. | | **Patch quality** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Needs a maintainer decision · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** An unfinished saved checklist can appear completed when its parent turn succeeds while delegated work continues. **Reason:** The visible inconsistency is demonstrated, but removing successful-run Completed presentation for nondelegated cards changes an intentional existing product behavior. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Blocked before merge - 2 items remain** Keep open: this PR addresses a verified current-main progress mismatch and contains meaningful, maintainer-engaged work; no new actionable code findings were established. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `79c379bebebeaaa5efda896a23db0faa13573994` **Owner decision:** Required. See [Decision needed](#decision-needed). ## Decision needed - **Question:** Should successful parent settlement stop producing Completed presentation on all saved progress-card surfaces, including sessions without delegated work? - **Recommendation:** **Approve authored completion everywhere:** Use saved step statuses for completion checks and counts, with live activity shown separately across all affected surfaces. - **Why:** The existing terminal presentation was intentional, this PR changes it globally, and the recorded re-review requests and integration commits do not explicitly settle that product choice. ## Before merge - [ ] **Complete next step** - The contributor must establish attribution for the startup-recovery and off-roster-route CI failures, repair demonstrated PR-caused defects, and satisfy the test-line gate through coverage-preserving consolidation or an explicit maintainer budget allocation. - [ ] **Resolve maintainer decision** - Resolve the maintainer decision shown above before merge. ## Findings None.
Agent review details ### How this fits together Gateway progress cards and session lifecycle observations feed shared Control UI presentation used by chat, Details, hovercards, board widgets, and plugin session summaries. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Saved progress card] --> D[Shared card presentation] B[Session lifecycle owner] --> C[Scoped session observations] C --> D C --> E[Delegated activity projection] E --> D D --> F[Control UI progress surfaces] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Preserve authored checklist truth through the existing shared presenter and session owners, with an explicit owner decision on successful-run presentation. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current main still maps a matching successful run to completed presentation for an authored in_progress step; supplied before/after browser evidence demonstrates the mismatch and repair, without a reviewer-run reproduction. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The shared presenter and existing session observations provide a coherent repair without changing stored plans; the broader replacement of deliberate successful-run presentation needs an owner decision. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. ([`ui/src/components/session-progress-card.ts:33`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/338c8118a27b5e7e9093f996f507c1bbb74ef9cf/ui/src/components/session-progress-card.ts#L33), [338c8118a27b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/338c8118a27b5e7e9093f996f507c1bbb74ef9cf)) - **Existing terminal presentation was deliberate:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/130183 deliberately introduced Completed terminal presentation; its merged history distinguishes this direction change from a mechanical repair. ([`ui/src/components/session-progress-card.ts`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/80b8e79778824cd1b86c1620ae76552c3f551c0f/ui/src/components/session-progress-card.ts), [80b8e7977882](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/80b8e79778824cd1b86c1620ae76552c3f551c0f)) - **Original target-observation contract preserved:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/137255 required progress to follow its captured target independently of dashboard membership; exact row observation preserves that contract and removes the bounded-roster dependency. ([`ui/src/lib/board/widgets/session-progress.tsx:106`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/79c379bebebeaaa5efda896a23db0faa13573994/ui/src/lib/board/widgets/session-progress.tsx#L106), [79c379bebebe](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/79c379bebebeaaa5efda896a23db0faa13573994)) - **Prepared visual evidence inspected:** Inspected all four downloaded screenshots: the baseline false checkmark, corrected delegated counts, visible child failure, and retained unfinished checklist in mobile Details after reload. ([`ui/src/e2e/session-progress-runtime.e2e.test.ts:20`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/79c379bebebeaaa5efda896a23db0faa13573994/ui/src/e2e/session-progress-runtime.e2e.test.ts#L20), [79c379bebebe](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/79c379bebebeaaa5efda896a23db0faa13573994)) - **Earlier findings are repaired:** The widget disposes and rebinds retired observations with captured-read guards, and delegated stopped counts use endedWithoutFinishing, which includes interrupted children. ([`ui/src/lib/board/widgets/session-progress.tsx:157`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/79c379bebebeaaa5efda896a23db0faa13573994/ui/src/lib/board/widgets/session-progress.tsx#L157), [79c379bebebe](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/79c379bebebeaaa5efda896a23db0faa13573994)) - **Current-head CI remains blocked:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/40599502101 reports startup recovery at chat-view.startup.test.ts:68, off-roster route waiting at chat-snapshot-route.e2e.test.ts:249, and the test-line ratchet as failed; the aggregate gate derives from these failures. Proposal only: this assessment does not dispatch repair, suppress jobs, mutate sibling items, close, or merge anything. ### Labels Label changes: - add `status: ⏳ waiting on author`: ClawSweeper has contributor-facing work open and is waiting for author action. - remove `status: ⏳ waiting on maintainer`: Current PR status label is `status: ⏳ waiting on author`. Label justifications: - `P2`: Misleading checklist completion affects progress monitoring without blocking the underlying agent workflow. - `rating: 🦐 gold shrimp`: Overall readiness is 🦐 gold shrimp; proof is 🦞 diamond lobster and patch quality is 🦐 gold shrimp. - `status: ⏳ waiting on author`: ClawSweeper has contributor-facing work open and is waiting for author action. - `proof: sufficient`: Contributor real behavior proof is sufficient. - `proof: 📸 screenshot`: Contributor real behavior proof includes screenshot evidence. ### Rating scale 6/6 🦀 challenger crab · 5/6 🦞 diamond lobster · 4/6 🐚 platinum hermit · 3/6 🦐 gold shrimp · 2/6 🦪 silver shellfish · 1/6 🧂 unranked krab. Overall follows the weaker of proof and patch quality; ✨ marks media proof (a screenshot, video, or linked artifact) that directly shows the changed behavior. ### Workflow ClawSweeper edits this one comment on every review.
